preconditions.description: The graph has n vertices (2 ≤ n ≤ 3e5), m edges (n-1 ≤ m ≤ min(3e5, n(n-1)/2)), and k special vertices (1 ≤ k ≤ n).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for v in v_special) and len(set(v_special)) == k
preconditions.description: The k special vertices are distinct and within the valid vertex range (1 ≤ v_i ≤ n).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c <= 10**9 for c in c_values) and len(c_values) == n
preconditions.description: Each vertex has a non-negative reward c_i (0 ≤ c_i ≤ 1e9).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= w <= 10**9 for w in w_values) and len(w_values) == m
preconditions.description: Each edge has a non-negative cost w_i (0 ≤ w_i ≤ 1e9) if left undirected.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == m and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: The graph has m edges, each connecting distinct vertices within the valid range (1 ≤ x_i, y_i ≤ n).

preconditions.expression: all(x != y for x, y in edges) and len(set((min(x, y), max(x, y)) for x, y in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: There is at most one edge between each pair of vertices (no duplicates).

postconditions.expression: len(output_profit) == n and all(isinstance(p, int) for p in output_profit)
postconditions.description: The output is a list of n integers, where the i-th integer (1-based) is the maximum profit when vertex i must be saturated.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= p <= sum(c_values) for p in output_profit)
postconditions.description: Each profit value is non-negative and does not exceed the sum of all vertex rewards (upper bound).

postconditions.expression: all(p_i == max(sum(c_j for j in saturated_vertices(i)) - sum(w_j for j in undirected_edges(i)) for saturated_vertices, undirected_edges in valid_configurations(i)) for i in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: For each vertex i (1-based), the output profit p_i is the maximum possible profit achievable when vertex i is saturated, computed as the sum of rewards for all saturated vertices minus the sum of costs for undirected edges in the optimal configuration. A configuration is valid if it directs edges (or leaves them undirected) such that vertex i is reachable from all special vertices, and the set of saturated vertices is maximal under this constraint.

postconditions.expression: all(vertex_i_saturated(i, directed_edges, undirected_edges) for i in range(1, n + 1) for directed_edges, undirected_edges in valid_configurations(i))
postconditions.description: In every valid configuration for vertex i, vertex i is reachable from all special vertices (saturated). The reachability is defined over the graph where undirected edges are bidirectional and directed edges are unidirectional.

postconditions.expression: all(undirected_edges.isdisjoint(directed_edges) and undirected_edges.union(directed_edges) == set(range(m)) for directed_edges, undirected_edges in valid_configurations(i) for i in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: Every edge is either directed (included in directed_edges) or undirected (included in undirected_edges), with no overlap.
